description: Main source file for Playwright test setup, including fixtures, test configuration, tracing, and utility functions.

classes.name: SnapshotRecorder
classes.description: Handles capturing and managing screenshots during tests, including temporary storage and attachment.

classes.name: ArtifactsRecorder
classes.description: Manages artifacts like screenshots and traces, coordinating their collection during test execution.

methods.name: normalizeVideoMode
methods.description: Normalizes various video mode inputs into a standard VideoMode string.

methods.name: shouldCaptureVideo
methods.description: Determines if video should be captured based on mode and test info.

methods.name: normalizeScreenshotMode
methods.description: Normalizes screenshot mode inputs into a standard ScreenshotMode string.

methods.name: attachConnectedHeaderIfNeeded
methods.description: Attaches headers from connected browsers to test info attachments.

methods.name: resolveFileToConfig
methods.description: Resolves file paths relative to the test configuration file.

methods.name: resolveClientCerticates
methods.description: Resolves paths for client certificates based on test config.

methods.name: connectOptionsFromEnv
methods.description: Creates connection options from environment variables.
